workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, I've checked the new list of 30-minute slots against Elena's and David's calendars. Unfortunately, none of them are free for both of them.

It seems we are not having much luck with our current approach. To make this easier, could you please send me the full busy schedules for Priya and Marcus for next week? If I have all four calendars, I can find a time that works for everyone. Let me know if that works for you.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, I've found a 30-minute slot that works for all four partners: Wednesday, November 18 at 12:00 PM Eastern. Please go ahead and book this in the firm's system. I will send the confirmation email to the partners now.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: The booking for Wednesday at 12:00 is confirmed. I've created the entry in the firm's booking system. Over to you to send the confirmation email.
